paragraphs.text: The Riptide Project was a conglomeration of blue wizards established around 4305 AR on Riptide Island , an island off the coast of mainland Otaria , Dominaria .

The Riptide Project was founded by Empress Llawan as a means to further the understanding of the magic of both the surface dwellers and the Mer Empire , in an attempt to repair relations between the surface and the Empire following the actions of Aboshan and Laquatus . Notably, much of the Riptide Project's research involved animals, such as reviving extinct species , creating new ones , or documenting the rapid evolution of existing ones following the Mirari 's activation in Krosa .

The most significant piece of research undertaken by the project was the study of slivers , based on remains discovered in the ruins of the Stronghold on Urborg . The project succeeded in recreating slivers and even creating new varieties, but without the control of the Sliver Queen , the slivers ran wild and slaughtered most of the researchers. They then escaped the island and made it to mainland Otaria, and soon they spread rapidly over all Dominaria .
It's been hinted that the Cabal also had an interest in the Riptide Project, but it's unknown if they were spying on the research academy simply out of curiosity or for more sinister reasons.

Of all the researchers that came to Riptide, there was only one researcher known to have survived the Slivers' devastating onslaught - a wizard named Pemmin , known for his enchantment spell called Pemmin's Aura .
